service.method: SELECT DOC_SEQ ,TYPE ,ROOT_PATH ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE FROM SFILE WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NO = ${attach_key} AND DOC_SEQ = $S{attach_seq} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ,'9999')
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(DOC_SEQ AS INT)),'0') MAX_SEQ FROM SFILE WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NO = ${attach_key}
